## Why Choose Wasalt for Daily Rentals?

##### Low Commission, More Profit

Enjoy a steady cash flow with guaranteed weekly transfers to your account.

##### More Visibility, More Bookings

Hassle-free renting, unlimited earnings!

## Explore the Features of Daily Rentals


##### Set Your Own Prices

Control your rates based on market trends, demand, or special occasions.

##### Adjust Availability Anytime

Need to block or update dates? Do it with one click and total flexibility.

##### Smart Booking Management

View, update, and manage all bookings from one place for a seamless experience.



Add your Daily Rental property

## How This Works

Find answers to common questions
## Frequently Asked Questions

 * ###### How do I list my property for Daily Rentals?

Sign up on Wasalt Business, add property details, set availability, and publish your listing. Apartments, villas, chalets, and other furnished accommodations suitable for short-term stays can be listed.

 * ###### Do I need a special license to list my property?

The license provided by the Ministry of Tourism is mandatory to list a property as a Daily Rental.

 * ###### How do I set my rental price?
You have full control over pricing and can adjust rates based on demand, seasonality, or length of stay.

 * ###### When do I receive my payouts?

Payouts are processed weekly, every Tuesday, for all check-ins of the past week, ensuring you get paid promptly.

 * ###### Are there any platform fees?

Wasalt charges a minimal platform fee, deducted from your earnings before payout.

 * ###### How does the booking process work?
When a guest requests to book your property, you have 8 hours to accept or decline. If no action is taken, the booking automatically expires. Guests can browse, select dates, and instantly book available properties through the Wasalt platform.

 * ###### Can I cancel a booking?

Bookings once accepted, are non-cancellable.

 * ###### Can I block dates when my property is unavailable?

Yes, you can manage your calendar and block dates when your property is not available for rent.
 * ###### What happens if a guest damages my property?

Wasalt provides free insurance coverage for hosts. If you have opted-in for the insurance, in case of damages, you can contact our support team.

 * ###### How quickly does my property go live after listing?

Once your listing is submitted, it goes live immediately for bookings.

 * ###### Can I list multiple properties?

Yes, you can list multiple properties under your account and manage them from one dashboard.
 * ###### Can I offer discounts for longer stays?

Yes, you can set special pricing for weekly or monthly stays to attract more guests.

 * ###### Can I update my listing's details?

You can edit your listing anytime, including pricing, availability, and property details.

 * ###### Can I require a security deposit from guests?

Yes, you can set an insurance amount for your listing, payable on arrival. which will be held in case of damages.

 * ###### Can I temporarily deactivate my listing?
Yes, you can pause your listing anytime and reactivate it when you're ready.

 * ###### Can I adjust check-in and check-out times?

You can choose check-in and check-out times for each listing.

 * ###### How can I make my listing more attractive?

High-quality photos, competitive pricing, detailed descriptions, and great reviews help boost your listing’s appeal.

Wasalt is a leading platform in Saudi Arabia for electronic real estate services, licensed by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA).

Saudi Arabia is the most sought-after country in the Middle East. Obviously, it is anything but a boring place to live. ## Top Cities to Visit in Saudi Arabia
### 1. Riyadh...Beyond Imagination
Starting off strong with the Kingdom’s capital, Riyadh, is the largest business hub in Saudi Arabia. It is where all the actual stuff goes down. So if you’re looking for a place to run a business, work at a successful company, or give your children a high-quality education, Apartments for Sale in Riyadh is where you should look! Riyadh is one of the wealthiest cities in the Middle East. This statement is both true from a cultural perspective and a materialistic one.
The city holds essential landmarks and historical sights, including the great Faisaliah Tower and The National Museum of Saudi Arabia. Most people travel to Riyadh to start their future there, as the job opportunities are anything but limited. So if you’re a hardworking young man with big city dreams, then Riyadh is where you should land. Also, if you’re a family man looking for a secure, luxurious place to settle down and live comfortably, you should look at Villas for Sale in Riyadh.
### 2. Jeddah Ghair
The famous slogan of Jeddah, “Jeddah Ghair”, is translated to “Jeddah is Different”, and indeed it is. Jeddah is the most light-hearted city in Saudi Arabia, where people come so they can participate in various events, including car racing and music concerts. Jeddah is made for those who want to be surrounded by natural scenery and crystal clear waterfronts. To live by the sea and enjoy blissful weather all year, you should start looking for Apartments for Sale in Jeddah.
Jeddah is also home to many international restaurants and cafes, with nicely built malls and commercial centres. For many people, Jeddah is considered a gateway to Makkah, a city worth passing by when performing the annual Hajj or pilgrimage. In a more religious sense, Jeddah is also home to beautifully built mosques and places of worship. A prime example of these mosques is Al Rahma Mosque, where you’d just be struck with awe when you visit it.
There are also several other landmarks, including Al Shallal Theme Park, which is loved mainly by children. There is also the breathtaking Saif Beach overlooking the beautiful Red Sea. Hurry up now and lead the life of your dreams by buying your next home from Properties for Sale in Jeddah.
### 3. Dammam…The Famous Commercial Hub of KSA
Dammam is a great city, from its picturesque corniche over the Persian Gulf to its contemporary architectural buildings. It is truly a city out of this world. Dammam is one of the Kingdom’s largest cities and has many wonders. Everyone living in Dammam has a great story to tell about where they visited the corniche or its historical sights. Moreover, Dammam has a collection of beautiful islands worth visiting.
So next time you’re in Dammam, make sure to bring your camera! Dammam is very famous for at the heart of the oil industry of Saudi Arabia, which makes it one of the wealthiest cities in the Kingdom, with endless job opportunities. To add the cherry on top, Dammam enjoys a wide range of luxurious neighbourhoods with top-notch Apartments for Sale in Dammam. Whether you are a tourist, native or ex-pat, Dammam is the ideal place.
Book your luxury stay in Dammam by browsing through Properties for Sale in Dammam.
### 4. Al Madinah Al Munawwarah…Home to Al Masjid Al Nabawy
The second holiest city in Saudi Arabia after Makkah is “Al Madinah Al Munawwarah”, which translates to “The Illuminated City”. Madinah is famous for being the city that welcomed Prophet Muhammad, Peace Be Upon Him during the struggles of delivering his message, and it came to be the city where his grave is located. Muslims worldwide visit Madinah to witness Al Masjid Al Nabawy, i.e., Prophet’s Mosque, and see the Prophet’s grave.
It’s a peaceful heart-warming city that will leave you overwhelmed with emotions. To become immersed in this blessed city, purchase a cosy home from Properties for Sale in Madinah. Aside from Al Masjid Al Nabawy, there are other historical landmarks worthy of visiting, such as the beautiful Uhud Mountain, which was where the Prophet and his followers fought the non-believers of Quraysh for the second time.
